ktk.text: Surrak, a young Temur, follows an inward chant into the wilds, tracks a giant bear in the snow, and fights it bare-handed with his claw gloves, losing an eye but winning by tearing at its neck until it retreats.
He returns to Karakyk with trophies and is given the rights of the grown and a greatspear, and he comes to lead a growing band of clan fighters.

When Sultai overrun his outnumbered Temur, the cave bear bursts in and rips through the Sultai ranks to his side, and Surrak later sends the dying, poisoned bear to the ancestors with the ancient chant.

He Who Whispers Twice marks him as the First Father of the Temur, and years later Surrak survives a blight spreading from his village, and Eshki and Alniul find him near death, so that the three commune with the spirits and pledge that all are welcome at the Temur fires, which ends the blight.
